paragraphs: Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Ze'ira of Kefar Ramin.

Zohar, Shemini 39b, tells a remarkable story about him. As an orphaned child he met Rabbi Yehudah and Rabbi Yitzchak and shared Torah insights learned from his father. They asked his name. He answered: “Yeisa.” They said: “You shall be Rabbi Yeisa.” On 41a there they called him “Rabbi Yeisa, the hammer that shatters rocks and sends flames in every direction.”

notes.text: The supplied edition already contains corrections to “orphan,” “hammer” and “rocks.” These are preserved; this local reading does not constitute a new scan verification.

The directly consulted Zohar, Shmini 6:73–74 names Yeisa and his departed father, Rabbi Zeira of Kefar Ramin; 13:97 has the hammer shattering rocks. These digital section references support the wording; the supplied printed 39b and 41a locators were not checked against facsimiles.
